leadText:
Captain Crook (Japanese: デボ Debo) is a character of the day who appeared in Viva Las Lapras. He is a pirate captain who has been known to poach Pokémon. He is the main antagonist of the episode.

He is a selfish and menacing character, who mistreats both his and crew members to get what he desires. His first mate, Ghali, keeps a lookout and alerts him to any promising targets. Captain Crook typically fires the ship's cannons at his target; however, these cannons are loaded with s, each one containing a , which the captain uses to subdue targets. He resorts to cannonballs when facing a threat from the authorities.
